actual_scope: Exact scalar test, on the merged PR6030 P104 word (PR5907 for comparison), of mid-word corrections for every PR5718-shape leak class of the PR6040 census: inserted chart-local ADDs whose source is (a) a carrier, a field whose original value is zero while it carries the retired helper's cut content (its split value is a multiple of the full defect z - row_p), or (b) a pure multiple of the new helper z (PR6040's r += q*new).
scope_change_reason: Takes PR6040's released step (3), output corrections at later meetings. Adds the non-z part that PR6040 left unmodelled: a pure-z correction clears the z-leak but leaves the defect -d_O x row_p on the original inputs, so the full defect direction must be corrected.
bottleneck_link: Complex currently binds the selected assembly; a zero-paid helper split adds H_r+H_s-H_(r+s) per LOCAL to the productive side. This census says which split shapes remain possible on the latest conditional P104 word.
stop_rule: Stop at one exact correction census with a planted positive control; do not build or price a split.
evidence: verify.py: pinned inputs; class census equals PR6040's counts on both words; carrier mode: 0 carrier sources in all 4,033 PR6030 and 4,206 PR5907 leak classes; pure-z mode on the 390 PR6030 leak-1 classes: 124 z-part witnesses, three single corrections checked directly to clear the z-leak and leave a non-z O defect; planted carrier+leak on PR5713 at PR5718's cut is found and accepted by the direct simulator, perturbed coefficient rejected; RESULT.json compared.

open_questions.question: Can several corrections with non-carrier sources combine to the rank-one defect d_O x (z - row_p) on O outputs?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This is the only correction route this package leaves open; a single correction or any carrier-source program is excluded on PR6030 and PR5907.
open_questions.first_step: For one leak-1 class, test at each later event and chart whether a combination of the fields there is zero in the original word but carries the cut content (rank of the field rows with the beta column appended).
open_questions.blocked_by: Speed: a direct Fraction rank test per event and class did not finish a 1/50 subsample in ten minutes; it needs incremental rank maintenance per chart.

open_questions.question: Does a correction that also rewrites an existing event (rather than inserting one) clear a leak class?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Inserted events are only one edit family; rewriting a coefficient changes the original map and is outside this test.
open_questions.first_step: Allow one existing ADD coefficient after the cut to change and repeat the defect equation.
